bandReport.notes: Item density varies by page: p1=1-7, p2=8-12, p3=13-17, p4=18-22, p5=23-27. Item 1 opens page 1 whole (nothing precedes it) and item 27 ends complete at the foot of p5-c2 immediately above the '[ P.T.O.' footer, with all four options printed, so nothing spills onto page 6 (which this band does not own). Page 6 should therefore open at item 28. No item number is skipped or repeated across the band. COLUMN CROPS: the c1/c2 split OVERLAPS slightly rather than slicing - the crop boundary sits a few millimetres to the right of the true gutter, so the c2 image reproduces a narrow strip of c1's right-hand edge down its left margin. This is visible as stray two- and three-letter fragments ('ow', 'ure', 'ith', 'ol', 've') down the left edge of p04-c2 and p05-c2, and as the centred page number appearing at the right edge of c1 AND the left edge of c2 on p1, p2, p3 and p5. It is duplication, not truncation: every line in each c1 crop terminates on a complete word with its punctuation, and the fragments in c2 match those same line-ends. No sentence, statement or option text was lost or misattributed, and no text crosses the gutter anywhere in the band. p05.png was consulted as a whole page to confirm this reading and to confirm the odd line-break in Q24 option (a) (see below); all text was otherwise read from the column crops in c1-then-c2 order. TYPESETTING, PRINTED AS-IS: (i) Q24 option (a) is set across two lines as 'Conducting 'Open Market' with 'Operations'' pushed to the far right of the following line - a justification artefact, not a missing word; it is transcribed as the single phrase the booklet intends. (ii) The booklet uses French spacing (a space before ':') in the 'Consider the following statements :' openers and in the 'Statement-I :' / 'Statement-II :' labels; this is preserved verbatim. It does NOT put a space before '?', unlike the 2022 booklet, and that too is preserved. (iii) 'Statement-I' / 'Statement-II' are printed with an en-dash; transcribed with a plain hyphen consistently in both stems and options so the two agree. (iv) Statement lists are numbered 1./2./3./4., not roman numerals. (v) Scientific names (Artocarpus heterophyllus, Madhuca indica, Tectona grandis, Guizotia abyssinica) are printed in italics; transcribed as plain text inside the parentheses the booklet prints. (vi) Q2 prints a genuine two-column data grid (headers 'Port' and 'Well known as') and is transcribed as a pipe table. NO PRINTED DEFECTS FOUND: every one of the 27 items carries exactly four options (a)-(d), no option text is duplicated within an item, no stem is garbled, and nothing in the band was illegible - no digit, letter or word was guessed. The five Statement-I/Statement-II items (11, 12, 21, 22, 23) all share the same four boilerplate options, which is the paper's standard format for that item type and not a duplication defect.
